# Canary — world risk status as_of 2026-11-03T05:51Z · next run ~11:40 UK · stale after 2026-11-03T19:51Z (36h for daily-tier signals) Assessed by an AI model (Anthropic Claude) against published rubrics; attention levels, not forecasts or advice. CC BY 4.0 · https://canary.danleech.com Basis: 26 measured from open data, 14 follow a published figure, 49 are AI judgements from news reports (weigh these with more caution). Known limitations: https://canary.danleech.com/methodology#known-limits
World State 40/100 (Strained) · 18 Alert · 39 Watch · 32 Normal Headline: Iran's offer to reopen Hormuz awaits a US reply as the 3 Nov US midterms begin; Brent near $105. Cyclone Murasu crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast early on 3 Nov. Russian strikes hit Kharkiv and Dnipro after 26 were killed in Zaporizhzhia.
## Situations (9 cross-domain events; Alerts below are grouped under them) - US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock [ALERT, stable]: Iran's 2 Nov offer to reopen Hormuz in two days awaits a US reply (3 Nov); a ship was hit in the strait on 2 Nov. Brent near $105. → alert: gulf-iran, middle-east, oil, eu-gas, fertiliser, chokepoints, freight, uk-energy-cap; watch: iran-nuclear, sanctions, semiconductors - Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank [ALERT, worsening]: Russian bombs killed 26 at a Zaporizhzhia aid point on 2 Nov; strikes hit Kharkiv, Dnipro and Kryvyi Rih on 3 Nov and Poland activated air defences. → alert: russia-ukraine; watch: russia-nato, hybrid-threats, nuclear-plants - Super El Niño [ALERT, worsening]: ONI +2.2: drought in Australia and East Africa, record warmth and weaker carbon sinks. → alert: enso, global-temp; watch: drought, co2, famine - Ebola outbreak, DR Congo [ALERT, worsening]: Africa CDC counts 5,376 Ebola deaths and about 10,444 cases to 2 Nov across DR Congo, Uganda and Kenya; a WHO emergency (PHEIC) since May. → alert: ebola; watch: who-emergencies - Sudan war [ALERT, worsening]: Record drone attacks on civilians in October; the army rejects talks; famine confirmed in 2025. → alert: sudan; watch: famine - Cyclone Murasu [ALERT, improving]: Severe cyclonic storm Murasu crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast near Ongole at about 01:00 local time on 3 Nov, winds 100–110km/h; GDACS red alert. → alert: other-cyclones; normal: floods - France: debt stress and protests [ALERT, stable]: OAT–Bund spread about 159bp (30 Oct); hundreds of thousands protested with clashes on 31 Oct, as unrest also hit Germany. → alert: sovereign-debt; watch: civil-unrest - Energy shock feeding inflation [WATCH, worsening]: US CPI at 4.0% on the oil shock; a Bank of England rise is widely expected on 5 Nov; Egypt hiked on 29 Oct. → watch: us-inflation, central-banks, uk-rates, bond-volatility; normal: em-stress - Record Binance hack attributed to North Korea [WATCH, stable]: About $6.3bn drained from Binance in late October; FBI blamed North Korea, which denied it on 3 Nov. Withdrawals reopened 1 Nov with heavy outflows. → watch: crypto, cyber, korea
## Other Alerts - Global food prices [food-prices] worsening: FAO food price index 136.0 in September, above the 135 Alert line; October due 6 Nov - Sahel insurgency [sahel] stable, AI-judged: JNIM's blockade of Bamako continues; Mali relies on escorted fuel convoys - UK terrorism threat level [uk-threat-level] stable: UK national threat level Severe: an attack is highly likely
